text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My body feels so heavy... I wonder 
if it's because I skipped yesterday's 
massage?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Or is it because I accidentally forgot to 
drink my raspberry juice...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Even on stream, I couldn't really bounce 
off the community members' comments well 
either..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because I've been so busy...? But I 
really don't want to skip streaming, 
either..."

It seems Loves Only You is worn out from 
consecutive races. It would be wise to 
reconsider our plans.
